brief:
Today, 12 November, is Push B. Pull A on 10 November and Legs A on 11 November are both in the log, and they moved the program in one place.

What changed: the crunch slot on Legs A and Legs B is now the ab crunch machine, in its own name, three sets of 10 to 12 starting at 65. You logged it as the ab machine on 7 November (55, then 65, 65 for 10) and again on 11 November (65 for 10, 10, 10), and the card kept asking for a cable crunch weight you were not using. Set counts do not change; abs stay at 8 a week. The dated swap for the dumbbell curl on 12 November is cancelled: all three sets reached 10.

How Pull A went (10 November, all logged live): deadlift 205, 225, 235, 240 for 6 each, one rep better on every set than 2 November, so the next Pull A asks 250 for 5 at the top. Wide pulldown 105 for 10, 120 for 12, 127.5 for 11 and seated row 105 for 12 on all four sets both earn a step next Pull A (135 and 112.5). Dumbbell curl 30 for 10, 10, 10 earns 35 next Pull A. Cable hammer curl 39 for 12, 42.5 for 11, 11 holds. Face pulls went lighter, 27 and 27.5 for 15. Cable lateral raise 10 for 12, 15.

You wrote on the seated row card: "Four sets? Does the science support any of your set counts?" The program sets a weekly range per muscle, and set counts come from that, not from a number per exercise. For this slot: upper back has 8 direct sets (seated row 4, chest-supported row 4), the floor of its range of 8 to 16; at three sets on the seated row it would have 7. Four sets of 12 with no drop-off says the weight is light, so next Pull A is 112.5, not a set cut.

How Legs A went (11 November, 58 minutes, 17 of 20 sets): leg press 200 for 10, 10, 10, all three at the top of the range; leg curl 150 for 12, 12, 12, which earns the next plate on Legs B; split squat 20 for 10, 10; leg extension 150 for 13, 13; adductor 90 for 15, 15; abductor 120 for 15, 15; crunch 65 for 10, 10, 10. No calf press is in the log for Legs A. If you did them, they did not save; if you skipped them, the slot already sits ahead of the hip machines and goes first on Legs A if the next Legs A misses it too.

Tonight, Push B, in pounds. Dumbbell shoulder press: 50 for 9 on all four sets (you did 50 for 8 four times on 4 November). Machine chest press: 135 for 10, then 150 for 10, 10, the top of its range twice; the log only has 135 and 150 on this machine, so no step is written, and if it has a weight above 150, take it and write it in the note. Dumbbell lateral raise: 15 for 15, three sets. Cable crossover high to low: 29 for 15, then 14. Reverse pec deck: 90 for 15, three sets; you did 90 for 15 on all three on 9 November, which earns the next step, but this machine's step size is not in the log, so take the next weight up and write it in the note. Rope pushdown: 49 for 12, three sets. Last slot, still logged as Overhead db press: 50 for 12, two sets. After Push B comes Pull B, then Legs B.

Open questions: whether that last Push B slot (Overhead db press, 50 for 12, 12 on 31 October and 4 November) is triceps or a shoulder press, one word in the note settles it, and if it is a press your triceps are at 6 direct sets, not 8. Your logs through 11 November are still stamped Meso 3, week 7, while the calendar says week 3 of the restarted block; if the phase tag at the top of the app is locked, the 25 November deload will not start by itself, and "Automatic (by date)" clears it. No bodyweight is logged since 23 August (207 lb). Conditioning: 2 to 3 low-intensity sessions of 20 to 30 minutes a week are allowed in the build block; nothing extra is asked tonight.

New since the 11 November review: two nights, Pull A on 10 November (all sets logged live) and Legs A on 11 November (58 minutes, 17 of 20 sets; the calf press is missing). Nearly every lift that ran earned a step: deadlift 240 for 6, wide pulldown 127.5 for 11, seated row 105 for 12 on all four, dumbbell curl 30 for 10, 10, 10, leg press 200 for 10, 10, 10, leg curl 150 for 12, 12, 12. That is what a build block should look like. The program changes in one place today, the crunch slot becoming the ab crunch machine on both leg days (version 10); session totals do not move (19, 21, 20, 20, 21, 20). The dated dumbbell curl swap for 12 November is cancelled because all three sets reached 10. It has changed often since the 28 October restart (versions 5 to 10), each time so a card matches what was logged. Next boundary is the deload on 25 November; the prep block is written at the assessment from what these four weeks log.
